name: Inferno race suspension (Apex V8)
_note: Race springs, dampers and anti-roll bars for the Apex with forged uprights and arms: 65% stiffer springs, 43% firmer damping, 20 mm lower, 45% stiffer bars, three times as tough, and it holds the wheels on twice as hard (wheelHold; with the Inferno wheels, five times). Flatter in corners and steadier at 400 km/h.
